messages.subject: User survey 2015 results
parts:
Hi distance samplers,

Thanks to everyone who contributed their thoughts to the 2015 user
survey. The quantitative answers have been plotted and you can look at
them here:

http://distancesampling.org/user-survey/results-2015.html

The development team met yesterday to look over the results and we are
making plans to address the issues you raised, as well as start to
analyse the long-form answers you provided. We'll post more updates on
this list and on distancesampling.org and contact those who wished to be
contacted about helping out directly.


Thanks again to all those who took part!

cheers,
--dave (on behalf of the Distance Development Team)
